finding.summary: The stock driver publishes the LED child and sysfs groups before probe-owned state and resources are fully initialized.
stock_order: vibrator_init registers the LED child and generic sysfs group
the probe creates the private workqueue and invokes AW function-table slot 1
misc registration and g_aw_haptic publication occur on the complete-success path
finding.risks: sysfs stores and LED callbacks could run while probe state is partial; the misc device could accept open before the wrapper has completed late interface registration.

evidence.observation: vibrator_init calls devm_led_classdev_register_ext and sysfs_create_group before hrtimer_init and state work/mutex setup
probe calls vibrator_init before haptic_init; later resource allocation and final misc/global publication follow
stock assembly for probe call ordering; table callback invocation at offset 0x5084
stock function table slot 1, offset 0x8, resolves to aw8693x_creat_node
hash-bound review of callback slot and registration call locations

candidate_changes.change: Replaces the LED registration and generic sysfs registration call instructions in vibrator_init with zero-success returns; preserves the remaining stock initialization sequence.
Makes vibrator_attribute_group globally visible inside the module so the lifecycle wrapper can publish it after probe completion.
Gates AW-specific group creation during stock probe; the lifecycle wrapper explicitly enables the call for late publication.

Requires a published client state and tracked misc registration; publishes LED child and both groups after stock probe success; opens the misc gate only after publication succeeds; on failure, sets shutdown and invokes aw_remove after releasing the transition lock.
Declares the new lifecycle and AW-node interfaces without changing the stock callback signatures.
Unchanged in this batch; its existing early LED unregistration remains the synchronous sysfs teardown point.
Joern-only model follows the candidate deferred-registration behavior; the preserved stock Ghidra output remains unchanged.

limitations: No runtime or hardware result is claimed.
The three changed functions are declared hardening deviations and are not stock-equivalent promotions.

The canonical offline audit remains incomplete because paired stock/Ghidra run inventory, assembly inventory, ABI/layout, microtask, current-stock KCFI, independent-review, and hardware evidence are missing.
